name: Chén Xián
source: Nero is a colleague from Data Analysis who suffers from severe social anxiety. His personal space has a circumference of two meters, and no outsiders are allowed inside it. Since Alpha Team's office is rarely crowded, he uses it to find some peace and quiet. That's why he's acquaintances with MC. Whenever issues related to Wanderers are brought up, he becomes a chatterbox.
